summary: @IMAC2 Folks should follow your example more than advice. Tinker to meet your own NEEDS and you meet those of others = revenue When you build to meet the needs of others you waste time making slide decks for investors to ignore
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@IMAC2 Folks should follow your example more than advice.

Tinker to meet your own NEEDS and you meet those of others = revenue

When you build to meet the needs of others you waste time making slide decks for investors to ignore
